# Welcome to my Webpage!<br>
## About me<br>
I did my bachelor's degree in Biology at the University of Central Florida. During my time there I became an author in a research article studying _myrmecophiles_ in the nests of the Florida carpenter ant, _Pogonomyrmex badius_. Now, I am a graduate student at the University of Puerto Rico Recinto Mayaguez with a focus on entomology and aquatic ecology.
